text: Don't buy anything in the sales until you've seen this. I asked Scout for a robot vacuum for pet hair, under five hundred. Same vacuum, two Aussie stores, almost thirty-seven dollars apart. This one's thirty bucks cheaper at Kmart than JB Hi-Fi. And this one? Two hundred and ninety-nine dollars under the brand's own store. Before you hit buy, check it with Scout. Scout. Launching November sixteen.
